question: What is the highest energy per capita score in 2020? In which country
query: SELECT MAX("energy_use_per_capita"), T1.country_name FROM global_development_indicators AS T1 INNER JOIN global_development_indicators AS T2 ON T2.year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year < 2020 AND country_code = T1.country_code) WHERE "energy_use_per_capita" = ( SELECT MAX("energy_use_per_capita") FROM global_development_indicators )
